title: Lowered proposal
$comment: Frozen as schema v1 at T1's gate (PLAN.md section 7), after the contract met live data on 18 and 19 September. Uses the keyword subset implemented by tools/validate.py; an unknown keyword is an error there, never ignored. Every change since 062a245 is listed in schema/CHANGES.md with the case that forced it; a change after the freeze needs a new schema_version and a row there.
description: What the kernel evaluates: primitives only. Families, snapshots and reductions have already been resolved by lowering; nothing here needs the registry or the network.

exposure.description: What the holder is exposed to. `linear` is spot and cannot be liquidated; `isolated_perp` can.

oneOf.description: An isolated perp, carried through lowering so a checker can re-derive the path reduction. `linear` alone could not: an IR that does not say what is exposed cannot say why the exposure was reduced.
Reserved for template.scalarPrice (T4). The oracle's evaluate() does not accept it yet.

with.description: The OTHER legs reduced together with `leg`, when a rule acts on a group rather than one leg. A band reduction is the infimum of the group's SUMMED payoff, and the infimum of a sum is not the sum of infima: two legs whose payoffs cancel have a flat sum that no basis move can hurt, while each alone is stepped. Reducing them separately invents a loss on a perfectly hedged position. Absent for a per-leg rule.

bound.description: The declared basis bound this reduction used, when the rule is a band. A checker re-derives the reduction, and a proposal may declare several bounds, so the one that was applied is stated rather than guessed. Absent when no bound was declared -- then the group is worth zero and there is no band.

reductions.description: Every lowering rule that lowered a leg's value, so a checker can re-derive and compare. A rule acting on a group states its other members in `with`.
